instruction.text: Lies den Text über Peter aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Hello everyone! My name is Peter, and I am going to tell you about my daily routine.

atoms.a:
Who wants to tell us something about his daily routine?
Wer will uns etwas über seinen Alltag erzählen?
atoms.sound: Who wants to tell us something about his daily routine?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Peter aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: I go to my office at eight o'clock .

atoms.a:
When does Peter go to his office?
Wann geht Peter in sein Büro?
atoms.sound: When does Peter go to his office?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Peter aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: At twelve o'clock I have to make a lot of phone calls.

atoms.a:
What does Peter do at twelve o'clock?
Was macht Peter um zwölf Uhr?
atoms.sound: What does Peter do at twelve o'clock?
b: ++He makes a lot of phone calls.
He makes a lot of pancakes.

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Peter aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: At five o'clock I like to play football in the park.

atoms.a:
When does Peter like to play football?
Wann spielt Peter gerne Fußball im Park?
atoms.sound: When does Peter like to play football?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Peter aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: At nine o'clock I usually sit on my couch and watch TV.

atoms.a:
When does Peter usually watch TV?
Wann guckt Peter meistens fern?
atoms.sound: When does Peter usually watch TV?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Peter aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: After a long day, I finally go to bed at half past eleven.

atoms.a:
When does Peter go to bed?
Wann geht Peter ins Bett?
atoms.sound: When does Peter go to bed?
